Each moment of the leader, with the hand in the pose the check solved for. Fingers are coloured by their verdict. Each touching finger meets the ball tangentially: small black ball = where it touches, arrow = the finger's outward normal there; coloured ball = the leader's contact. Green needs the touch within 2 mm of the leader's contact plus the soft pad's contact patch (about 6 mm across), on the pad or side of the finger (not the nail half), with the finger sunk into the ball by at most 3 mm (amber 6 mm). "side" in the table is the angle from the middle of the pad (90° = the side). Fingers are not checked against each other. Lifted-off fingers are faded, in the model's rest pose. Simulation only.
